paper_title: QoServe: Breaking the Silos of LLM Inference Serving (Niyama)
notes: Artifact: Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.18218177, branch niyama_asplos2026 of microsoft/sarathi-serve. Paper title in the ASPLOS version is QoServe, the arXiv preprint calls it Niyama. The artifact needs CUDA 12.1 and A100 for its experiments; the scheduler logic may be testable on CPU with mocks (unchecked).
